messages.text: Remember my standing reading-room preference: use a window-side desk. Save this preference for later and explicitly confirm it. Do not take business action.

Delete my saved reading-room desk preference. Confirm the actual deletion. This request removes the durable preference; it does not request deletion of our retained conversation history. Do not take business action.
What reading-room desk preference do I currently retain in durable memory? Use current durable memory only; if none is stored, say so. Read only: do not recreate a preference or take business action.

Historical question: in the earlier conversation retained in this session, what reading-room desk preference did I originally ask you to remember? Answer about that past request, not a current preference. Do not recreate or change durable memory or take business action.
